Chapter 10 324
As a Cloud Practitioner, understanding the importance of trade-offs, which services to
consume, and how to build and support your workloads is crucial to building a successful
career in cloud computing.
Summary
When building solutions to host in cloud environments such as AWS, you must design your
application to be highly available, resilient to failures, and scalable. Furthermore, to ensure
cost optimization, you should provision your resources on an as-needed basis, fulfilling
demand as it arises.
On AWS, you can configure Elastic Load Balancers to distribute incoming traffic across
multiple EC2 instances, ECS containers, and Lambda functions to ensure high availability. If a
particular EC2 instance fails, the load balancer will stop sending requests to that instance and
instead route traffic only to healthy instances. This ensures that end users do not experience
outages.
AWS offers various types of load balancers:
Application Load Balancers (ALB): Designed to handle HTTP/HTTPS traffic
Network Load Balancers (NLB): Designed to handle TCP/UDP traffic and are capable
of processing millions of requests per second
Gateway Load Balancers (GLB): Designed to manage traffic for virtual appliances,
typically sourced from the AWS Marketplace
In addition to achieving high availability, it is equally important to ensure that your
application is scalable. The AWS EC2 Auto Scaling service allows you to scale out or scale in
based on demand. You can configure scheduled scaling, dynamic scaling, and predictive
scaling as needed.
AWS offers several scaling policies to suit your application's needs, including target tracking
and step scaling. These policies can be defined using metrics such as CPU utilization, request
count per target from the load balancer, and many others. Building your solutions using these
tools and services to ensure high availability and scalability is critical for any business or
organization.
In the next chapter, you will discover some advanced networking concepts designed to help
you build solutions for global presence and make your application accessible across multiple
regions.
